questions.label: Does the enclave handle ITAR technical data?
questions.help: No: standard tier, commercial AWS regions. Yes: ITAR tier, AWS GovCloud (US), client-side encryption in Workspace, and a separate GovCloud signup.

questions.label: CUI categories handled
questions.help: Comma separated CUI Registry category names.

validation.pattern_message: Letters, digits, spaces and . , & ' ( ) / + @ _ - only; start with a letter or digit.

questions.label: CUI confidentiality impact (FIPS 199)
questions.help: 32 CFR 2002 requires CUI to be protected at no less than moderate confidentiality.

questions.label: CUI integrity impact (FIPS 199)
questions.help: Not set by CUI rules. How much harm would unauthorized changes to this CUI cause?

questions.label: CUI availability impact (FIPS 199)
questions.help: Not set by CUI rules. How much harm would losing access to this CUI cause?

questions.label: Number of enclave users
questions.help: People with access to CUI. Used for the license estimate and the SSP.

questions.label: Offices and alternate work sites
questions.help: Comma separated. Write "remote only" if there are no offices.

questions.label: Google Workspace tenant
questions.help: New: the checklist starts with creating and verifying the tenant.

options.label: I already have a Workspace tenant

questions.label: Workspace edition
questions.help: Default: Enterprise Plus with Assured Controls Plus. Assured Controls without Plus is a documented fallback. Anything else is unsupported and generates POA&M items.

options.label: Enterprise Plus with Assured Controls Plus (default)

questions.label: Workspace customer ID
questions.help: Admin console, Account settings. For a new tenant, leave blank and set customer_id in terraform/workspace.auto.tfvars.json after the tenant exists.

validation.pattern_message: Starts with C followed by letters and digits, such as C03abc123.

questions.label: Terraform admin email
questions.help: A super admin that the Terraform service account impersonates. For a new tenant, the address you will create.

questions.label: Audit collector admin email
questions.help: Admin the Workspace audit collector impersonates. Blank: same as the Terraform admin.

questions.label: Users to create (optional)
questions.help: One per line: email, given name, family name, cui or non_cui. Leave blank to leave existing users untouched (the default).

questions.label: Group enclave-admins: members
questions.help: Administrators of the workload and grc accounts. Emails, one per line or comma separated. They are also Identity Center group members in AWS.

questions.label: Group enclave-auditors: members
questions.help: Read-only auditors across all accounts.

questions.label: Group fathom-operators: members
questions.help: People who operate Fathom in the grc account.

questions.label: Group logging-admins: members
questions.help: People who administer the log archive.

questions.label: Do you already run MDM (mobile device management) on enclave devices?
questions.help: No: the checklist adds a purchase item and POA&M items for device controls (gaps #43).

questions.label: Do you already run EDR (endpoint detection and response)?
questions.help: No: the checklist adds a purchase item and POA&M items for malicious code protection.

questions.label: Do you already have an AWS Organization?
questions.help: No: the org stack creates it from the management account you run Terraform in. Yes: it reads the existing one (all features, policy types and trusted access must already be enabled), and you can list member accounts that already exist.

questions.label: Root email: log archive account
questions.help: Four distinct addresses never used for another AWS account, at mailboxes you control.

questions.label: Existing account ID: log archive (optional)
questions.help: Only if this member account already exists; it is not created or moved. Place it in the right OU by hand or import it.

questions.label: Home region
questions.help: Standard tier: commercial US regions. ITAR tier: GovCloud regions.

questions.label: Tag owner
questions.help: Required by the tag SCP: EC2, EBS and RDS creates are denied without owner, environment and data-classification.

questions.label: Security notification emails
questions.help: Receive security findings and alarms. One per line or comma separated.

questions.label: Fathom domain (optional)
questions.help: Hostname for Fathom, such as grc.acme-defense.com. Blank: set it later; Fathom is reachable only after DNS and a certificate exist.

questions.label: Fathom ACM certificate ARN (optional)
questions.help: Certificate in the grc account and home region, if you already have one.

questions.label: Fathom Google OAuth client ID (optional)
questions.help: Client ID only. Never enter the client secret here: it goes into AWS SSM by hand (see the checklist).

questions.label: Fathom bootstrap admin emails
questions.help: Workspace accounts that become Fathom administrators on first sign-in.
